blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Binary Neural Networks (BNNs) enable efficient deep learning deployment on resource constrained devices with weights and activations compressed to one bit, substantially reducing model size and inference cost.
Event cameras offer complementary advantages, including low latency, high dynamic range, and low power consumption, by capturing asynchronous streams of events rather than dense image frames.
Despite their shared emphasis on efficiency, the combination of these technologies remains largely unexplored.
This work aims at adapting and evaluating modern deep BNN architectures on event data.
We also show that cross-modal pretraining from RGB data can improve the classification accuracy of BNNs on neuromorphic datasets.
We introduce the Polar-wise Binary Event Volume (PBEV), a binary representation that enables event-camera data to be processed directly by BNNs and represents a step toward fully binarized event-based vision systems.
Best evaluated BNN on N-Caltech101 classification benchmarks shows 90.58% accuracy with 7.5 × \times less operations than their full-precision counterparts.
blocks.zh:
二进制神经网络(BNNs)使得能高效地在资源受限设备上进行深层学习部署,重量和活化被压缩到一位,大大降低了模型大小和推论成本.
事件相机通过捕捉事件同步流而不是密集的图像帧,提供了互补优势,包括低潜伏度,高动态范围,以及低功耗等.
尽管它们都强调效率,但这些技术的结合在很大程度上仍未得到探讨。
这项工作旨在对事件数据的现代深BNN架构进行改造和评价.
我们还表明,从RGB数据进行跨模式预训可以提高神经形态数据集上BNN的分类精度.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Event cameras, also known as neuromorphic cameras, enable new vision capabilities by producing asynchronous, sparse streams of events rather than dense image frames captured at fixed rates. Offering an ultra-low latency
and a high dynamic range, event cameras show robustness in scenes with varying lighting conditions while requiring lower power consumption by avoiding redundant data [ 6 ] .
Currently, there are two main ways to implement neural networks for event data.
First are Spiking Neural Networks (SNN), which address the asynchronous and spike nature of the event flow but require specific neuromorphic hardware for deployment.
Second are classic artificial and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), which rely on pseudo-frame generation from event accumulation, reducing the inherent ultra-low latency of the camera.
Binary Neural Networks (BNN) offer lighter models and lower power consumption, suiting embedded inference speeds and better preserving the events’ low-latency benefit.
While progress has been made on BNNs, it remains unclear how they perform compared to classical CNNs and SNNs on neuromorphic data.
We evaluate accuracy and computational load of state-of-the-art binary and full precision architectures on event camera classification datasets across a range of accumulation windows and event representations (summarized in Figure 1 ).
blocks.zh:
事件相机,也叫神经形态相机,通过产生同步而稀少的事件流来使新的视觉能力成为可能,而不是以固定速率捕获到的密集图像帧. 提供超低潜伏
和高动态范围,事件相机显示在各种照明条件的场景中坚固,同时需要通过避免冗余数据来降低功耗 [6].
目前,实施事件数据神经网络有两种主要方式.
第一是Spiking神经网络(SNN),它处理事件流的同步和突起性质,但需要特定的神经形态硬件来部署.
二是经典人工和革命神经网络(CNN),它们依靠事件积累产生的伪帧生成,减少了相机所固有的超低纬度.
二进制神经网络(BNN)提供更轻的模型和更低的能耗,适合嵌入式推论速度,更好地维护事件低纬度效益.
虽然在BNNs方面取得了进展,但与古典有线电视新闻网和SNNs相比,在神经形态数据上它们的表现仍然不明朗.

blocks.en: Our contributions can be listed as follows: • We introduce a novel Polar-wise Binary Event Volume (PBEV) representation for events. It is an efficient way to represent an accumulation of events into a binary tensor for direct processing with binary models. • We benchmark state-of-the-art deep convolutional BNNs on event-based classification through an extensive evaluation against a full-precision CNN baseline across multiple event representations and accumulation schemes, and position the results against literature CNN, SNN and transformer results on two datasets, N-Caltech101 [ 29 ] and N-ImageNet-mini [ 16 ] . • We analyse how representation, accumulation time, and cross-modal pretraining impact learning and generalization. • We highlight how all tested BNN architectures can equal and surpass the full-precision CNN baseline ResNet-18 on event dataset, while requiring from 7 × 7\times up to 21 × 21\times less operations.
blocks.zh: 我们的捐款可开列如下: 我们介绍一部小说"极地二进制事件卷"(PBEV)代表事件. 它是将事件累积成二进制式以直接处理二进制模型的有效方法。 我们通过对多种事件表述和积累计划的全面精确的CNN基线进行广泛评价,以事件分类为基准,将最新动态BNN作为基准,并将结果与文献CNN、SNN和变压器结果放在两个数据集上,N-Caltech101[29]和N-ImageNet-mini[16]。 我们分析代表性、积累时间和跨模式预先培训的影响学习和概括。 我们强调所有测试过的BNN架构如何在事件数据集上等于和超过全精度的CNN基线ResNet-18,同时需要从7×7\times到21×21\times减少操作.

blocks.en: We introduce a novel Polar-wise Binary Event Volume (PBEV) representation for events. It is an efficient way to represent an accumulation of events into a binary tensor for direct processing with binary models.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍一部小说"极地二进制事件卷"(PBEV)代表事件. 它是将事件累积成二进制常数,用二进制模型直接处理的有效方法.

blocks.en: We benchmark state-of-the-art deep convolutional BNNs on event-based classification through an extensive evaluation against a full-precision CNN baseline across multiple event representations and accumulation schemes, and position the results against literature CNN, SNN and transformer results on two datasets, N-Caltech101 [ 29 ] and N-ImageNet-mini [ 16 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们通过对全精确的CNN基线进行广泛的评价,把最新深度演化的BNN作为基于事件的分类基准,并参照文献CNN、SNN和变压器在N-Caltech101[29]和N-ImageNet-mini[16]两个数据集上得出结果。

blocks.en: We analyse how representation, accumulation time, and cross-modal pretraining impact learning and generalization.
blocks.zh: 我们分析代表性、积累时间和跨模式预先培训的影响学习和概括。

blocks.en: We highlight how all tested BNN architectures can equal and surpass the full-precision CNN baseline ResNet-18 on event dataset, while requiring from 7 × 7\times up to 21 × 21\times less operations.
blocks.zh: 我们强调所有测试过的BNN架构如何在事件数据集上等于和超过全精度的CNN基线ResNet-18,同时需要从7×7\times到21×21\times减少操作.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Advances in Deep Binary Neural Networks
blocks.zh: 2.1 深二元神经网络的进展

blocks.en:
The primary appeal of these extremely compressed networks lies in their deployment efficiency and hardware compatibility, with real implementation on FPGA.
A practical application of the state-of-the-art BNext model was deployed on an FPGA, achieving 72.6 FPS [ 40 ] inference for its small variant and an energy consumption below 19W (on ZCU102 FPGA).
blocks.zh:
这些极其压缩的网络的主要吸引力在于其部署效率和硬件相容性,在FPGA上得到真正的执行.
在FPGA上实际应用了最先进的BNext型号,对其小变体和能量消耗低于19W(在ZCU102 FPGA上)达到了72.6 FPS[40]推论.

blocks.en: Deep BNNs
blocks.zh: 深BNNs( 深 BNNs)

blocks.en:
To scale BNNs to complex classification datasets, modern architectures have relied on the same core breakthroughs that advanced standard CNNs.
For instance, residual connections [ 24 ] can propagate real-valued activations around binary convolution blocks, thereby mitigating the loss of representational capacity caused by binarization. Batch normalization [ 36 , 3 ] can improve optimization stability and control activation distributions during BNN training.
By adapting these classical deep learning techniques, along with BNN-specific refinements like learnable threshold optimization [ 23 , 19 , 22 ] and knowledge distillation methods tuned to reduce BNNs overfitting [ 9 ] , binary networks can now converge effectively on large-scale tasks.
blocks.zh:
要将 BNNs 规模化为复杂的分类数据集,现代建筑已经依靠了与高级标准CNN 相同的核心突破.
例如,剩余连接[24]可以在二进制回旋区块周围传播实际值活化,从而减轻二进制造成的代表能力损失. 批量正常化[36,3]可以在BNN训练期间改善优化稳定性和控制活性分布.
通过调整这些古典的深层学习技巧,加上BNN特有的改进,如可学习的阈值优化[23,19,22]和知识分馏方法来调制来减少BNN的过量相配[9],二进制网络现在可以有效地聚合到大规模的任务上.

blocks.en:
Binarization has also been extended to transformer backbones, where the central difficulty is finding an accurate 1-bit encoding for the queries, keys and values inside attention [ 12 , 18 ] .
Binarization has even reached language processing, with BiBERT [ 32 ] yielding a fully binarized BERT, and complete Large Language Models built on binary operations [ 41 ] .
blocks.zh:
Binarization也被扩展至变压器主干线,其中中心困难是找到准确的1位编码,用于关注内部的查询,密钥和值 [12,18].
二进制甚至达到了语言处理,由BiBERT[32]产生完全二进制的BERT,由二进制操作所构建的完整的大语言模型[41].

blocks.en: Training BNN
blocks.zh: BNN培训

blocks.en:
A major bottleneck remains training: most BNNs require substantially longer training to converge. BNNs usually rely on a 2 steps training protocol [ 24 ] , the first one is to binarize only activations, then both activations and weights. [ 22 ] explain why Adam optimizer outperforms stochastic gradient descent on BNNs.
The authors also study how training strategies affect the retention of the initial weight signs, using a correlation-to-initialization metric. Knowledge distillation [ 13 ] is a training strategy for a smaller student network to match a larger teacher’s soft output distribution rather than only the hard ground-truth labels, used in many BNN training pipelines.
While 1-bit activations limit feature map expressivity, they also act as implicit regularization [ 9 ] .
blocks.zh:
一个主要的瓶颈仍然是培训:大多数BNN需要相当长的培训才能汇合。 BNNs通常依靠2个步骤的训练协议[24],第一个是只将活化二进制,然后是活化和重量. [22]解释为什么亚当优化器在BNNs上优于有花样的梯度下降.
作者还研究了培训战略如何使用相关到初始化的衡量标准,影响初始体重标志的保留. 知识分馏[13]是一个较小的学生网络的培训策略,以匹配更大的教师软产出分配,而不仅仅是许多BNN培训管道中使用的硬地-真实标签.
虽然1位活化限制了特征映射表达性,但它们也起到隐含的正态[9].

blocks.en: Neuromorphic Learning
blocks.zh: 神经形态学习

blocks.en:
On suitable event-driven hardware, SNNs can replace many dense multiply–accumulate (MAC) operations with conditional synaptic accumulations triggered by spikes.
Deep spiking CNNs like TMC [ 44 ] adds temporal calibration to increase temporal gradient diversity.
SpiLiFormer [ 46 ] introduces a lateral inhibition mechanism into spiking transformers to reduce attention distraction towards irrelevant tokens.
blocks.zh:
在合适的事件驱动硬件上,SNNs可以以由突起所引发的有条件的突触积累来取代许多密集相乘-累积(MAC)操作.
TMC [44]等深层喷发的有线电视新闻网增加了时间校正,以增加时间梯度多样性.
SpiLiFormer [46] 将平相抑制机制引入了平相变压器来减少注意力分心去向无关的活物.

blocks.en:
To benefit from the huge quantity of static RGB images, many SNNs rely on transfer learning strategies.
Works like [ 11 ] apply domain sliding training: training the spiking backbone initially on RGB data then progressively shifting the input distribution toward events, so that RGB learned representations carry over into the event data domain.
Building on this mechanism, CKD [ 45 ] additionally distills logits from an RGB teacher.
TMKT [ 43 ] interpolates RGB and event inputs as a curriculum to bridge the modality gap for domain alignment.
blocks.zh:
为了从大量的静态RGB图像中受益,许多SNN依赖于转移学习策略.
例如[11] 应用域滑动训练:最初在 RGB 数据上培训被跃出的主干线,然后逐渐将输入分布向事件转移,这样 RGB 学到的表示会传入事件数据域.
在这种机制的基础上,CKD[45]额外地从一个RGB教师那里提取了日志.
TMKT [43] 将RGB和事件输入相插为课程,以弥补域对齐的模式差距.

blocks.en: Whether trained purely on events or from RGB, all of these networks remain spiking at inference and share the same bottleneck: the evaluated configurations commonly use 10–16 timesteps [ 20 , 39 , 46 , 44 ] , which increases the number of sequential updates and may raise latency and computational cost.
blocks.zh: 无论是纯粹接受事件培训,还是接受RGB培训,所有这些网络仍然在推想中振奋并共享同样的瓶颈:被评价的配置通常使用10–16分时步[20,39,46,44],这增加了相继更新的次数并可能提高耐久性和计算成本.

blocks.en: Full precision models
blocks.zh: 全精度模型

blocks.en:
To compensate for the scarcity of large-scale event datasets, the most performing methods adapt vision transformers with feature alignment from reference models trained on internet scale image data.
EventBind [ 47 ] binds event, image and text embeddings for contrastive learning into a shared
CLIP [ 33 ] space.
EventBind reliance on a large CLIP ViT backbones may limit its suitability for resource constrained deployment.
With even more compute resources, GEP [ 2 ] uses a similar technique to align an event encoder to a RGB foundation model (DINOv2) before training on the Event-1.8M, a dataset with 1.8M event-image pairs drawn from
various representative neuromorphic datasets.
These methods report among the highest published accuracies under their respective evaluation protocols (Table 1 ), but largely by inheriting the parameter count and pretraining cost of large RGB foundation models.
blocks.zh:
为了弥补大规模事件数据集的稀缺性,最能发挥作用的方法是调整视觉变压器,使其与互联网规模图像数据培训的参考模型的特性相匹配。
EventBind [47] 绑定事件、图像和文本嵌入,用于对比学习到共享
CLIP [33] 空间.
依赖大型CLIP ViT主干网可能会限制其适合受资源限制的部署。
GEP [2] 利用更多的计算资源,在对事件-1.8M进行训练前,使用类似的技术将事件编码器与RGB基础模型(DINOv2)相配合,该数据集包含从中提取的1.8M事件-图像对.
各种具有代表性的神经形态数据集。
这些方法是在各自评价协议下(表1)公布的最高速率之一,但主要通过继承大型RGB基础模型的参数计数和预培训费用。

blocks.en:
Other methods apply transfer learning , through simple weights pretraining, or domain alignment technique.
Pretraining is used in [ 16 , 17 ] , with [ 16 ] applying also cross-modal pretraining from RGB.
Domain alignment is adopted by STP [ 21 ] , who freezes a RGB pretrained backbone and adds modules specialized for events to make the features compatible.
blocks.zh:
其他方法应用了转移学习,通过简单的权重预训,或域对接技术.
预先培训在[16,17]中使用,其中[16]也适用来自RGB的跨模式预先培训.
域对接被STP [21]所采用,被冻结一个RGB预训主干线,并添加用于事件的专门模块来使特性相容.

blocks.en: In addition, MEM [ 17 ] trains a variational autoencoder and employs a masked patches technique to self-supervise a ViT backbone for events from unlabeled data, before fine-tuning for classification.
blocks.zh: 此外,MEM [17] 培训了可变自编码器,并采用遮罩补丁技术,对未加标签的数据中的事件进行自控ViT主干线,再进行分类的微调.

blocks.en:
GCNs have also been proposed to process events [ 37 , 15 ] .
They process the sparse flow in a spatio-temporal graph where each event is a vertex, avoiding a lossy compression to a pseudo-frame.
Despite this advantage, processing a graph is heavier than classic networks layers, and GCNs are not as deep as CNNs.
blocks.zh:
还提议全球网络处理活动[37、15]。
它们用斯皮提奥-时态图处理稀有的流量,其中每个事件都是顶点,避免了被损失压缩到伪框.
尽管有这一优势,处理一图比经典网络层更重,而GCN的深度不如CNN.

blocks.en: 2.3 Bridging BNNs and Event Vision
blocks.zh: 2.3 连接BNN和事件展望

blocks.en:
Despite the potential compatibility between binarized event representations and 1-bit neural architectures, the application of BNNs to neuromorphic vision is largely unexplored.
Existing literature is limited to low-power applications such as 3-class parking lot monitoring [ 34 ] and denoising for pedestrian detection [ 4 ] .
Prior binary event representations such as the Binary Event Image (BEI) [ 5 ] and the Binary Event History Image (BEHI) [ 42 ] binarize the input representation, but the subsequent neural processing is not necessarily fully binarized.
We hypothesize that because event data natively represents event/no event per pixel and polarity, it can be encoded directly into dense binary formats.
This lets a BNN ingest space-time event volumes natively,
enabling the convolutional core to rely predominantly on XNOR–popcount operations.
blocks.zh:
尽管二进制事件表征和1位神经架构之间有潜在的相容性,但BNNs对神经形态视觉的应用基本上没有被探索.
现有文献仅限于三等座停车场监测等低功率应用[34]和为行人检测取名[4].
先前的二进制事件表示,如二进制事件图像(BEI)[5]和二进制事件历史图像(BEHI)[42]将输入表示二进制,但随后的神经处理不一定完全二进制.
我们假设,因为事件数据在本质上代表了事件/每个像素和极度没有事件,所以可以直接被编码成密集的二进制格式.
这让一个BNN摄入时间 活动在本土,
让革命核心主要依靠XNOR-popcount操作.

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Datasets
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据集

blocks.en: Event datasets originate either from live recordings (unbiased but rare and task-specific), from frame-to-event simulation (limited by the source camera’s dynamic range and frame interpolation noise), or from pan-tilt recordings of static images, which conveniently produce large annotated datasets with a real sensor at the cost of true object dynamics.
blocks.zh: 事件数据集的出自活录(不带偏见但罕见且任务特定),从帧到事件模拟(受源相机的动态范围及帧内插噪声的限制),或从静态图像的平板记录,这种记录方便地产生带有真实传感器的大型附加说明的数据集而以真实物体动态为代价.

blocks.en:
Here we use pan-tilt recordings that reproduce large and influent computer vision datasets.
N-Caltech101 [ 29 ] is the event-based translation of Caltech101 [ 7 ] while N-ImageNet [ 16 ] is from ImageNet [ 35 ] , N-ImageNet-mini is a 100-class subset from it.
Datasets used in our benchmark are detailed in Table 2 .
blocks.zh:
在这里,我们使用泛平板录音 复制大型而流畅的计算机视觉数据集。
N-Caltech101 [29]是Caltech101 [7]的事件翻译,而N-ImageNet [16]则出自ImageNet [35],N-Image Net-mini是它的一个100等子集.
我们基准中使用的数据集详见表2。

blocks.en: Table 2 : Summary of used datasets. Occupancy ratio is defined as the average ratio of pixels triggering at least once during the full sequence over the number of pixels.
blocks.zh: 表2: 所用数据集摘要。 占用比被定义为像素在整序期间触发至少一次的平均比值与像素数相比.

blocks.en:
These datasets have different characteristics.
Although they contain approximately the same mean total number of events, N-ImageNet’s sensor has roughly seven times more pixels and samples are approximately 6,000 times shorter than N-Caltech101 ones, resulting in a lower occupancy ratio.
N-Caltech101 is made to be processed with long accumulation times, it empirically provides too few events to be processed with durations below 5 ms.
When observing accumulated pseudo-frames, N-ImageNet presents sparse and thin edges due to its very short sample length while N-Caltech101 provides denser renderings 2 .
The very short duration of N-ImageNet samples makes this dataset very challenging, but also a step to solve for low latency events processing with few aggregated events.
blocks.zh:
这些数据集具有不同的特性.
N-ImageNet的传感器虽然含有大致相同的平均事件总数,但比N-Caltech101的像素大约多出7倍,样品比N-Caltech101短出约6000倍,因此占用率较低。
N-Caltech101是用长的积累时间来加工的,从经验上讲,它提供了太少的事件,而持续时间低于5ms.
N-ImageNet在观察所积累的伪框时,由于其样本长度非常短而呈现出稀疏而薄的边缘,而N-Caltech101则提供了更稠密的渲染2.
N-ImageNet样本持续时间非常短,使得这个数据集非常具有挑战性,但也是一个解决低延迟事件的步骤,很少汇总事件.

blocks.en: 3.2 Evaluated Architectures
blocks.zh: 3.2 评价的建筑

blocks.en:
We select three state-of-the-art deep convolutional BNNs originally applied to images and one full-precision CNN baseline for our comparisons.
Following the knowledge distillation procedure to train BNNs (see section 2.1 ), we adopt EventBind [ 47 ] , a state-of-the-art full-precision transformer, as the teacher.
The networks are listed as follows and their complexity is reported
in section 3.4 .

blocks.en: 3.3 Polar-wise Binary Event Volume Representation
blocks.zh: 3.3 极地二进制事件数量

blocks.en:
In recent BNN architectures, the first layer is kept in full precision.
As a result, the number of floating-point operations (FLOPs) increases with the number of input channels.
We adapt both the input representation and the network architectures by replacing this real-valued first layer with a binary layer, yielding binary-input variants of each network.
This reduces
computational overhead while leaving the remainder of the architecture unchanged.
This design limits the increase in computational cost associated with higher-dimensional inputs.
blocks.zh:
在最近的BNN建筑中,第一层保持了完全精确.
因此,浮动点操作(FLOP)的数量会随着输入通道的数量而增加.
我们调整了输入表示和网络架构,用二进制层来取代这个真实值的第一层,产生每个网络的二进制-输入变体.
这样可以减少
计算间接费用,而结构的其余部分不变。
这种设计限制了与更高维度输入相关的计算成本的增加.

blocks.en:
To enable this fully binary input processing, we introduce the Polar-wise Binary Event Volume (PBEV) encoding.
It consists of a stack of short time-slices formed into a 3D tensor with each polarity considered separately, similar to the polar-wise variant [ 31 ] of Event Volume [ 48 ] (PEV).
In PBEV, each slice is coded strictly as a binary channel representing the presence or absence of events at a given position.
Unlike a 2D BEI,
the PBEV sub-samples the accumulation time window and preserves most of the temporal density of the event flow.
blocks.zh:
为了能够完全实现二进制输入处理,我们引入了极光二进制事件卷(PBEV)编码.
它由一叠短长的相片组成了三维抗热器,每个极性单独考虑,类似于事件卷[48] (PEV)中极性变体[31].
在PBEV中,每个切片被严格地编码为二进制通道,代表特定位置是否存在事件.
不像二维BEI,
PBEV子标出积累时间窗口并保存了事件流的大部分时间密度.

blocks.zh: 3.4 复杂性计算

blocks.en:
Network complexity is linked to the quantity of parameters and of operations.
Operations OPs [ 27 ] combine binary and floating-point operations (FLOPs) following this formula: O ​ P ​ s = B ​ O ​ P ​ s / 64 + F ​ L ​ O ​ P ​ s OPs=BOPs/64+FLOPs .
As shown in Table 3 , binarizing the input layer makes a 6-channel binary-input variant cheaper than its own 2-channel full-precision-input counterpart ( e.g. 48 vs. 51 M OPs for ReActNet), leaving the final linear layer as the only remaining source of real multiplications.
blocks.zh:
网络的复杂性与参数数量和业务量相关.
操作 OPs [27] 按照此公式结合了二进制和浮动点操作(FLOP) : O P s = B O P S / 64 + F L O P s OPs=BOPs/64+FLOPs.
如表3所示,将输入层作二进制,使得6个通道的二进制变体比自有的2个通道的全精度输入对等体(例如48对51 M OPs for ReActNet)更便宜,使得最终的线性分层成为了唯一剩下的真实相乘来源.

blocks.en:
A&B BNN is built on top of ReActNet, having approximately the same number of parameters but replaces the multiplication operations with
more efficient bit operations [ 25 ] : it drops batch normalization in favor of scaled weight standardization, absorbs the scaling activation multiplications into the sign function at inference, and constrains its PReLU slopes to integer powers of 2.
For comparability, Table 3 counts these shift and addition operations as regular FLOPs, so the reported A&B BNN totals are a loose upper bound.
blocks.zh:
A&B BNN 建于 ReActNet上方, 参数数量大致相同, 但将乘法操作替换为
更高效的位操作 [25] :它降低批量常态,有利于分量重量标准化,在推断时将分量活化乘法吸收到符号函数中,并限制其PRELU斜率为整数功率为 2.
就可比性而言,表3将这些转移和添加操作算作常规的FLOP,因此所报告的A&B BNN总计是一个松散的上限.

blocks.en:
BNNs efficiency stands in contrast to state-of-the-art full-precision models like EventBind ViT-L/14, which demands over 902 M parameters and a staggering 10.4 TFLOPs.
Even compared to advanced binary networks like BNext Small, which requires 67.21 M parameters and 120 M OPs.
blocks.zh:
BNNs的效率与EventBind VIT-L/14等最先进的全精度模型形成对比,后者需要超过902M参数和惊人的10.4TFLOP.
即使与BNext Small等高级二进制网络相比,它也需要67.21 M参数和120 M OPs.

blocks.en:
We do not compare BNNs to SNNs complexity in this work, as most SNN reduce drastically the input resolution (see Table 1 ), lowering the number of parameters and operations.
Also, the theoretical Synaptic Operations (SOP) proposed in [ 28 ] depends on the neurons firing rate, which is time-dependent.
blocks.zh:
在这项工作中,我们并不将BNNs与SNNs的复杂性相提并论,因为大多数SNN会大幅降低输入分辨率(见表1),降低参数和操作的数量.
另外,在[28]中提出的理论突触操作(SOP)取决于神经元的发火率,这种发火率取决于时间.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en: To assess the effectiveness of BNNs on event data, we benchmarked on the N-Caltech101 [ 29 ] and N-Imagenet-mini [ 16 ] classification datasets against the several architectures of Section 3.2 representing different efficiency and capability tradeoffs. Beyond raw accuracy, our experiments aim to evaluate the adaptability of these models across varying event representations and accumulation times.
blocks.zh: 为了评估BNNs在事件数据上的有效性,我们以N-Caltech101 [29]和N-Imagenet-mini [16]分类数据集作为基准,参照了代表不同效率和能力取舍的第3.2节的若干架构. 除了原始准确性外,我们的实验旨在评估这些模型在不同事件表现和积累时间的适应性。

blocks.en: 4.2 Event Representations
blocks.zh: 4.2 事件陈述

blocks.en:
We compare four families of event encoders: density-based 2D histograms [ 26 ] , time-based Surfaces of Active Events [ 1 , 30 ] , 3D Event Volumes (or Voxels) [ 31 ] , and binary representations as Binary Events presence Image [ 5 ] and proposed Polar-wise Binary Event Volume. The specific representations and configurations compared in our experiments are detailed in Table 4 .
Since binary convolutions are far cheaper than real-valued ones
(Section 3.4 ), PBEV’s channel count can be scaled at
minimal compute cost, enabling wide inputs with fast inference, whereas
real-valued inputs scale poorly. We use 6 channels as a representative
multi-bin setting, matched by the non-binary PEV6 for a direct comparison.

blocks.en: 4.3 Implementation details
blocks.zh: 4.3 详细执行情况

blocks.en: Data temporal sampling
blocks.zh: 数据时间抽样

blocks.en:
N-Caltech101 samples are 300 300 ms long. To probe the accuracy–latency trade-off we accumulate events over windows of 5 5 , 10 10 , 20 20 , 50 50 , 100 100 , 200 200 and the full 300 300 ms. For a window shorter than the sample, events are taken from a sliding temporal window: at training time its start is sampled uniformly around the sample centre, providing an extra layer of temporal augmentation, whereas at test time the window is centered on the middle timestamp. The dataset is resized to 160 × 160 160\times 160 following [ 49 ] .
We use the 8:2 train/validation split released by EventBind [ 47 ] , which also serves as the test set as the dataset provides no separate test partition. For N-ImageNet-mini, we use the full 50 ​ μ ​ s 50\,\mu s samples, resized to 224 × 224 224\times 224 , with the authors’ train/validation splits. Validation used as test set.

blocks.en: Full-precision baseline training
blocks.zh: 完全精确的基线培训

blocks.en:
Training settings are chosen empirically using a grid search strategy, to optimize accuracy and avoid overfitting.
The ResNet-18 baseline is trained for 200 200 epochs ( 100 100 on N-ImageNet-mini) with cross-entropy on the labels and Adam optimizer, a learning rate of 3 × 10 − 3 3\times 10^{-3} , a weight decay of 10 − 4 10^{-4} and batch size of 128. We use a cosine-annealed learning rate with a 5-epoch linear warmup.
blocks.zh:
训练设置是按经验选择的,采用网格搜索策略,以优化精度并避免过于匹配.
ResNet-18基线为200个世纪(在N-ImageNet-mini上为100个世纪)训练,标签上标有横切并有Adam优化器,学习率为3×10-3\times 10^{-3},体重衰减为10−4 10^{-4}分批大小为128. 我们使用一个共和无氧的学习速率 用一个5世纪的线性热身。

blocks.en: BNNs two-step training and knowledge distillation
blocks.zh: BNNs 两步培训和知识分解

blocks.en:
Each BNN follows a two-step schedule [ 27 ] .
We run 200 200 epochs per step on N-Caltech101 and 100 100 epochs per step on N-ImageNet-mini to reduce computation time, at an initial learning rate of 10 − 2 10^{-2} .
Learning rate is instead set to 10 − 3 10^{-3} for A&B BNN’s pretrained runs to limit optimization collapse.
We did not use Adaptive Gradient Clipping from A&B BNN throughout: enabling it lowered accuracy on the representations and did not resolve the collapse.
Following [ 22 ] , ReActNet and A&B BNN use Adam with a step-1 weight decay of 5 × 10 − 6 5\times 10^{-6} , BNext Small uses AdamW with a differentiated decay ( 10 − 3 10^{-3} for real-valued and 10 − 8 10^{-8} for binary parameters).
The three BNNs are trained with knowledge distillation from an EventBind teacher [ 47 ] we trained ourselves (Section 3.2 ).
We followed the distillation technique [ 13 ] with temperature scaling setting of T 2 = 2 T^{2}=2 , without mixing ground-truth labels. All runs use a cosine-annealed learning rate with a 5-epoch linear warmup. All models are trained with a batch size of 128, except BNext for N-ImageNet-mini, where we used 64 to fit within the same 32GB memory.

blocks.en: Cross-modal Pretraining
blocks.zh: 跨模式先行培训

blocks.en:
We adopt a direct weight warm-start initialization from RGB pretraining as experienced in [ 16 ] rather than feature alignment or distillation.
Hence, models then skip the two-step schedule and train in a single binary stage ( 100 100 epochs) warm-started from RGB ImageNet weights: for 2-channel inputs we drop the first convolution’s green channel, and for 6-channel inputs we duplicate the three RGB channels.
ResNet-18 is likewise initialized from ImageNet and trained for 100 100 epochs.
blocks.zh:
我们从[16]中经历的RGB预训中采用直接重温启动初始化,而不是特征对接或分馏.
因此,模型跳过双步时间表,在单一的二进制阶段(100个世纪)进行训练,从RGB ImageNet重量开始:对于两道输入,我们放弃了第一个演化的绿色通道,对于六道输入,我们重复了三个RGB通道。
ResNet-18也从ImageNet初始化,为100个世纪培训。

blocks.en: Accuracy when trained from scratch
blocks.zh: 从零开始训练的准确性

blocks.en:
As the accumulation window increases, the models ingest more contextual information, often leading to higher classification accuracy on N-Caltech101 (Table 5 ), but representations differ in effectively using that extra time, as illustrated in Figure 3 .
The BEI, that discards events timing and density, saturates early:
it peaks at short windows (best 82.42% at 50 ms with BNext, and as early as 20 ms for ReActNet) and then degrades.
But overall, it offers the lowest accuracies.
Conversely, the 6 bins temporal volume PEV6, able to keep most of events timing and density, keeps improving up to the full extract, reaching the overall best result for every backbone
(84.84% at 300 ms with BNext).
EventCount, PBEV6 and SAE, all dropping either the events density or timing, sit between these extremes, each within roughly two points of the PEV6 optimum at their own best time window (83.34% at 20ms, 82.54% at 50ms and 83.11% at 50ms respectively, all with BNext).
Unlike PEV6, the related PBEV6 representation stops improving with the longest accumulation times.
For a single shot, end-to-end latency is the accumulation window plus one forward pass, so this window choice sets the latency.
blocks.zh:
随着积累窗口的增加,模型吸收更多的背景信息,往往导致N-Caltech101的分类精度提高(表5),但是,如图3所示,在有效利用这一额外时间方面表现方式不同。
BEI,它抛弃事件的时间和密度, 饱和早期:
它在短窗上最高峰(最高峰为82.42%,与 BNext 相接50 ms, 并最早为 20 ms for ReActNet),然后降解.
但总的来说,它提供了最低的速率。
反之,6 bins 时间量 PEV6 能够保持大多数事件的时间和密度,不断改善到全部提取,达到每个主干体的总体最佳结果
(84.84%,300ms与BNext).
EventCount, PBEV6 和 SAE 都降低了事件密度或时间, 都位于这些极端之间, 大约在 PEV6 最佳时间窗口的两分之内( 分别为 83.34% , 82.54% , 50 ms 和 83.11% , 均为 BNext)。
与PEV6不同的是,相關的PBEV6代表状态随着最长的积累时间而停止改善.
对于一发一发,端到端的耐用是积分窗口外加一发前传,因此这个窗口选择设定了耐用.

blocks.en:
Comparing N-Caltech101 and N-ImageNet-mini (Table 6 ), this ranking inverts.
For the N-ImageNet-mini very short samples duration, the 6 bins representations not only loose their advantages in time encoding, they also drastically reduce the final accuracies.
PEV6, while being the best encoder for every backbone on N-Caltech101, collapses on N-ImageNet-mini, most severely for ResNet-18 whose accuracy falls to 28.14% (the worst of all).
The dense two-channels EventCount and SAE are the strongest representations for N-ImageNet-mini, achieving respectively 47.86% and 43.62% accuracy with BNext, again the best backbone.
This shows that for ultra short accumulation times ( i.e. sparse samples as sown in Figure 2 ), we shall consider to simplify the input representation and drop events timing or density, allowing for denser channels.
Compared to N-Caltech101, the lower best scratch accuracies illustrate how N-ImageNet-mini is harder to process.
Distilled binary networks already match or exceed the full-precision baseline from scratch on both datasets, with BNext leading on both.
blocks.zh:
比较N-Caltech101和N-ImageNet-mini(表6),这一排名倒数.
对于N-ImageNet-mini的样本持续时间非常短,6个宾斯的表示不仅在时间编码中松散了优势,它们也大大地减少了最终的快感.
PEV6虽然是N-Caltech101上每个骨干的最佳编码器,但是在N-ImageNet-mini上崩溃了,最严重的是ResNet-18的精度下降到了28.14%(最差).

这表明,对于超短的积累时间(即图2所显示的稀有样本),我们将考虑简化输入表示并降低事件的时间或密度,允许更密集的通道.
与N-Caltech101相比,下等最好的刮痕快感说明了N-ImageNet-mini如何更难处理.
抖动的二进制网络已经从头到尾匹配或超过两个数据集上的全部精度基线,BNext领先两个数据集.

blocks.en: Effect of cross-modal pretraining
blocks.zh: 跨模式预先培训的效果

blocks.en:
Fig. 3 shows pretrained models surpass scratch training for every time window, representation and architecture except A&B BNN with PBEV6.
Tables 5 and 6 report the gain Δ \Delta per representation and architecture, each at its own optimal window: binary networks exploit the pretrained initialization more than the full-precision baseline does.
On N-Caltech101, BNext benefits the most and most consistently ( + 5.40 +5.40 to + 6.09 +6.09 ), ahead of ReActNet ( + 3.33 +3.33 to + 4.82 +4.82 ), itself ahead of the full-precision ResNet-18 baseline ( + 2.64 +2.64 to + 3.96 +3.96 ). A&B BNN pretrained on EventCount is the exception: it collapses at long accumulation windows, falling to 27.63%
and below from 100ms.
Its architecture uses scaled weight standardization rather than batch normalization, so once pretrained it has no activation normalization to absorb EventCount’s raw magnitude, which grows with the accumulation window.

图3显示,每次窗口、代表性和架构中,除A&B BNN和PBEV6外,预先训练过的模型都超过了抓痕培训。
表5和表6报告每个表示和架构的增益 \\Delta, 各自在自己的最佳窗口: 二进制网络比全精度基线更能利用预先训练的初始化.
在N-Caltech101上,BNN在ReActNet(+3.33+3.33++4.82)之前,本身在完全精准的ResNet-18基线(+2.64+2.64+3.96+3.96)之前,对BNN进行最大和最一致的惠益(+5.40+5.40到+6.09+6.09). A&B BNN在EventCount上预训是例外:它倒塌于长堆积窗口,跌至27.63%.
和以下从100ms。
它的架构采用分级重量标准化而不是分批正常化,因此一旦经过预先训练,它就没有启动正常化来吸收EventCount的原始数量,而这种数量随着积累窗口而增加。

blocks.en: N-ImageNet-mini shows similar gains, with a bigger step up for PEV6 and PBEV6, and higher relative benefits for ReActNet than BNext. A&B BNN gains are lower and it collapses again with EventCount. These rankings are consistent with the architectures’ designs. Binarization lets all three BNNs afford deeper networks than ResNet-18 at a fraction of its cost (Table 3 ). Among BNNs, BNext extends and invests over twice ReActNet’s parameters and operations, while A&B BNN trades accuracy and training stability for hardware-oriented simplifications, notably the removal of batch normalization.
blocks.zh: N-ImageNet-mini也显示出类似的收益,PEV6和PBEV6的升级幅度更大,ReActNet的相对收益也高于BNext. A&B BNN 增益更低,随着 EventCount 再度倒闭. 这些排名与建筑设计一致. Binarization让所有三个BNN都能提供比ResNet-18更深层次的网络,其成本是其成本的一小部分(表3). 在BNN中,BNext扩展并投资了超过两倍的ReActNet的参数和操作,而A&B BNN则为以硬件为导向的简化进行精度和培训稳定性交易,主要是取消批量正常化.

blocks.en: Binary representations: accuracy and efficiency
blocks.zh: 二进制表述:准确性和效率

blocks.en:
Binary inputs are competitive with most state-of-the-art methods on N-Caltech101 (Table 1 ), with the proposed PBEV6 slightly ahead of BEI (Table 5 ).
PBEV6 with BNext (88.45%) or ReActNet (86.79%) surpasses the best full-precision ResNet-18 result (best at 86.33% with PEV6) at an 8.6 × 8.6\times efficiency gain.
PBEV6 does not behave exactly as PEV6 on longer time windows, preventing it to reach as good accuracies (in Figure 3 , PBEV6 looses accuracy from 100ms). Despite this, from 10 to 50 ms accumulation times, PBEV6 results are equivalent to SAE and EventCount and closer to PEV6, while allowing for binary input layers, making it the best choice when shorter latencies are required.
On N-ImageNet-mini, however, the very short samples coded as PBEV6 do not carry enough information to match the best representations (SAE and EventCount).
Binary inputs remain attractive because they are extremely cheap to generate, let the binary networks themselves stay lighter and efficient with short time windows, even lighter than the 2-channels non-binary representations such as SAE and EventCount (Table 3 ).
They suit constrained hardware and gives a favorable accuracy/complexity trade-off (Fig. 1 ).
blocks.zh:
二进制投入在N-Caltech101上与大多数最先进的方法具有竞争力(表1),提议的PBEV6略高于BEI(表5)。
PBEV6带有BNext(88.45%)或ReActNet(86.79%)超过最佳全精度ResNet-18(与PEV6相比最高为86.33%)的成绩,以8.6×8.6\时效率增益.
PBEV6在较长的时间窗口上的表现不完全像PEV6,使其无法达到良好的快感(在图3中,PBEV6从100ms松出精度). 尽管如此,从10到50 ms的积累时间,PBEV6的结果相当于SAE和EventCount,并更接近PEV6,同时允许二进制输入层,成为在需要更短的后期时最好的选择.
然而,在N-ImageNet-mini上,编码为PBEV6的非常短的样本没有携带足够的信息来匹配最好的表示(SAE和EventCount).
二进制投入仍然具有吸引力,因为生成成本极低,所以让二进制网络本身在短时间窗口上保持更轻和高效,甚至比SAE和EventCount等2个通道的非二进制代表更轻(表3).
它们适合受限制的硬件,并具有有利的准确性/复杂性取舍(图1)。

blocks.en:
From scratch, each binary network’s final signs are uncorrelated with its own random initialization. Table 7 shows every architecture sitting at the 0.5 0.5 floor on both datasets.
Training therefore fully discards and is independent from the random starting point.
With RGB pretraining, final signs remain correlated with the initialization.
Table 7 shows C2I rising to 0.73 0.73 – 0.88 0.88 for every architecture on both datasets, well above the scratch floor. A&B BNN’s collapsed N-Caltech101 cells depart from this range instead, reaching 0.995 0.995 : training there leaves the backbone frozen at its pretrained starting point rather than adjusting it.

因此,培训是完全抛弃的,独立于随机起点。
随着RGB预训,最终的标志仍然与初始化相关.
表7显示C2I上升至0.73 0.73 — 0.88 0.88,在两个数据集的每个架构上,远高于刮伤底. A&B BNN倒闭的N-Caltech101细胞则偏离了这个范围,达到0.995 0.995:在那里的训练使得骨干被冻结在它经过预先训练的起点,而不是调整.

blocks.en: 4.6 Theoretical computation time
blocks.zh: 4.6 理论计算时间

blocks.en:
We do not measure on-device latency in this work, but
we report the existing Xilinx ZCU 102 FPGA board implementation of BNext that sustains 72.6 FPS [ 40 ] , that is an estimated ≈ \approx 14 ms per inference.
According to Table 3 , BNext Small is the heaviest BNN compared in our benchmark, so we can expect even faster inference for ReActNet and A&B BNN.
blocks.zh:
我们并不衡量这项工作的延迟性,但
我们报告目前Xilinx ZCU 102 FPGA 董事会执行BNext, 维持72.6 FPS [40], 估计每个推论大约为 \\ 14 ms。
根据表3,BNext Small是我们基准中最重的BNN,因此我们可以期望ReActNet和A&B BNN的推论更快.

blocks.en:
We report also the GCN EFGCN [ 15 ] , which processes events as point clouds and measures between 4.4 to 9.3  ms per inference on a ZCU104 SoC FPGA.
This performance comes at a real accuracy cost, reaching between 62.8 to 64.1% accuracy on N-Caltech101, 20 points below the BNNs at similar 50 ms accumulation windows.
For real implementations, pseudo-frame representations competitive at short time windows are attractive for low latency neuromorphic vision systems.
blocks.zh:
我们还报告GCN EFGCN [15],它把事件作为点云处理,并按ZCU104 SoC FPGA推论,对4.4至9.3毫秒的测量。
这种性能以真实的精度成本来产生,在N-Caltech101上达到62.8%到64.1%的精度,在相类似的50ms积分窗口下20分BNN.
对于实际执行来说,在短时间窗口中竞争的伪框架表示对低常态神经外观系统具有吸引力.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We show that modern Binary Neural Networks can match or exceed full-precision accuracy on event-camera data while substantially cutting computational cost, when trained with knowledge distillation from a strong teacher and cross-modal pretraining. Under this regime, BNNs outperform ResNet-18 on N-Caltech101 (90.58% accuracy with a non-binary 6-channel input at 7.5 × 7.5\times fewer operations, up to 21 × 21\times fewer for our binary-input configurations) and likewise outperform the full-precision baseline on the harder N-ImageNet-mini. Our Polar-wise Binary Event Volume and fully binary input blocks extend binarization to the input layer, letting a six-channel representation require fewer operations than a conventional two-channel input on an unmodified BNN. We further find that the best event representation depends primarily on the sensor’s event-density and accumulation regime rather than on architecture alone, and that RGB-pretrained weights offer a useful prior that binary networks retain and exploit.
blocks.zh: 我们显示,现代二元神经网络可以匹配或超过事件-相机数据的全部精度精确度,同时在经过强师的知识分馏和跨模式预训培训后,大幅度削减计算成本. 在这个制度下,BNNs在N-Caltech101上(90.58%的精确度,非二进制6-通道输入,操作次数减少7.5x7.5xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx 我们的极相二进制事件量和完全二进制输入块将二进制延伸至输入层,使六道表示需要的操作比常规的两道输入在未修改的BNN上少. 我们进一步发现,最佳事件表现主要取决于传感器的事件密度和积累制度,而不是仅仅取决于建筑结构,而RGB预先调整的权重在二进制网络保留和开发之前提供了有用的依据。

blocks.en:
However, our evaluation is limited to classification on pan-tilt recordings of static scenes, with complexity estimated theoretically rather than measured on target hardware.
Future work should focus on natural event recordings, measure on-device latency and energy consumption, further explore the capabilities of binary input representations, improve the robustness and generalization of binary models, and extend the approach to tasks such as object detection. Together, these are steps toward low-latency, resource-efficient neuromorphic vision.
blocks.zh:
然而,我们的评价仅限于对静态场景的平板录音进行分类,其复杂性在理论上估计,而不是在目标硬件上衡量。
未来工作应注重自然事件录音,测量设备空隙和能耗,进一步探索二进制输入表示能力,提高二进制模型的稳健性和通俗性,将方法推广到物体检测等任务. 这些都是向低纬度、资源效率高的神经形态视觉迈进的步骤。
